title: Bedroom inside the mall
content: Does anyone also dreams that there is a personal bedroom inside the mall? Sometimes I dream that I have a room in there as if it was a store with glasses for walls like a showcase, but it is your bedroom? When I have those dreams, I always feel uncomfortable with the glass showcase, but as it’s a lucid dream, I pull “curtains” like I’m shutting down a store so I can have more privacy. Sometimes I feel like other people hae rooms there too and sometimes it’s mixed with stores.
